name: s81sl_xr3
structural_change: S81-XR3 10-20 (XR3-CLS): structural redesign after the first xr3 route s81sl_xr3-6585bf71d failed TT -144.7 ps (913 reg->reg D pins; worst eb[25] -> 3 wire buffers -> mine_e -> ce -> cp mux -> tgt0/lmask0 decode -> wire -> rwr[2] = REACH + DEPTH of the one-cycle stage-1 classify across the 570-um outline). C3 (HB != 0) now classifies in TWO registered stages: stage 1a per SOURCE (E / N(W) / V / B, beside its input flops): own mine / kind flags, target one-hot, per-leaf row-write and RD enables, RD leaf > 4, pairs/row, raw words eb1/wb1/vb1/bb1 + the SO B header, per-face sid one-hot (2 hops) -- KEPT reset-free copies (<= 17 stage-1b loads each); stage 1b = the XR7 stage-1 registers fed by OR / priority of the registered one-hots (<= 3 levels), so every long E->W wire carries a registered one-hot only. C1 (closed s81sl_xr1f) keeps the single stage (CLS 0: same expressions). SAFE checklist: 1 pins PASS (source-registered; reset_landing 2 stages); 2 reach FIXED (no cross-source logic on a tile-spanning wire: E/N face -> 1a -> 1b -> W face consumers = 3 hops over <= 570 um; sid strap 2 hops; data words 4 hops pin->eb1->eb2->ud->sw_d); 3 fanout FIXED (1a copies sized <= ~17 loads; 1b kept copies as XR7; SO enables 64+64 as ROOT4); 4 depth FIXED (stage 1a <= ~8 levels per source, stage 1b <= 3); 5 storage PASS (no runtime-indexed flop arrays); 6 floorplan waived-with-reason (pin-bound, outline 570.24 x 395.28 unchanged, aspect 1.44, no macros); 7 clock PASS (km16 regional roots, pin-flop spread by the --cts gate, io_hold_margin 0.03); 8 schedule FIXED: one contract -- C3 == C1 with every ring / V / band input (incl. the SO gather words) landing 1 edge later, leaf-side inputs undelayed, so the whole C3 slice timeline moves +1 edge and all in-slice relative timing is unchanged; handed to the die schedule (S-tier V CTL inject 8 vs 7) and priced (<= 0.009 % AR/MTP) in results/rtl/s81_xr3_1020/SCHEDULE.json.

job.purpose: S81 C3 control-plane sub-leaf ot_s81sl_xr3: XR3-CLS two-stage classify (reach + depth fix of route 6585bf71d); C3 = C1 + 1 edge on ring/V/band inputs.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (ot_s81sl_xr header); recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

pin_reg_split_why: XR6 fallback (FOREG=1): fault leaves a dedicated output flop (fault <= fcore), no recirculation at the pin flop, so io_flop_at_pins anchors it; no pin_reg_split.
outline_why: ROOT4-S81POST 10-19: first xr3 (C3, HB 1) kit, from the closed s81sl_xr1f kit: same faces + the band port B (bi 1104 in, bo 513 out) on S (the slice band face: pvrd lands bi from below, bo feeds the svc entry q below). Pin-bound: 9,268 pins; S 3,276 on 570.24 um = 5.9/um sets the width, E 2,214 on 395.28 = 5.7/um the height (as xr1f); ranges spread uniformly per face, scalars 2.16 um, clk at the E-face centre. Util ~7% (std ~16k um2 est.): the 40-60% target is unreachable without cutting boundary bits (slice seam architecture), as xr1f.
